assignment.title: Find the maximum value
assignment.instructions: Write a function find_max(nums) that returns the maximum integer in a non-empty list. Consider negative integers.

criteria.title: Correctness
criteria.description: Returns the maximum for positive, negative, and mixed integer lists.

criteria.description: Uses clear names and a straightforward structure.
